## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base assignment evaluates nominal stress at a prismatic rectangular section using a lower-segment cut. Local bend, pin-contact, bolt, fatigue, and stress-concentration effects are intentionally reserved for later analysis.
:::
